summary: First-finish smoke test of Clipper barber ERP. Backend endpoints (auth, services, barbers, inventory, appointments, public booking) all functional. Public multi-step booking UI works end-to-end (service -> barber -> date/time slots with availability filtering). CRITICAL: AI purchase order generator returns HTTP 200 but empty SSE stream because Emergent LLM key is over budget (litellm BadRequestError: 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0'). Auth UI (Google OAuth landing) renders correctly; interactive Google flow not executed (mocked via manual DB session for backend tests).
passed: GET /api/public/org_demo001/availability filters out already-booked time slots (14:00 removed after booking)
POST /api/public/org_demo001/appointments creates appointment and logs mocked WhatsApp confirmation
GET /api/auth/me works with Bearer token from manually inserted session
POST /api/services creates new service; DELETE removes it
Inventory endpoint correctly flags is_low_stock=true for items below min_stock
Frontend landing page renders Clipper login card with 'Iniciar sesión con Google' CTA
Public BookingFlow renders steps 1-3 with data-testid='booking-service-card', barber selection, and dynamic time slot grid

failed.issue: POST /api/inventory/generate-order returns HTTP 200 but streams no content. Backend logs show litellm.BadRequestError: 'Budget has been exceeded! Current cost: 0.0, Max budget: 0.0' from Emergent LLM key. Client receives empty stream with no error surfaced. Also model 'gemini-3.5-flash' string is unusual (typical is gemini-2.0-flash / gemini-1.5-flash) and may not be valid.
failed.evidence: Backend log: 'emergentintegrations.llm.chat.ChatError: Failed to start streaming completion: litellm.BadRequestError: OpenAIException - Budget has been exceeded' at /app/backend/server.py:535. Curl returns HTTP:200 with empty body.

action_items: Fix Emergent LLM key budget/quota so Gemini streaming works, OR replace/rotate EMERGENT_LLM_KEY in /app/backend/.env
Verify model identifier passed to LlmChat.with_model('gemini','gemini-3.5-flash') is correct - Gemini 3.5 Flash is uncommon; consider 'gemini-2.0-flash' or 'gemini-1.5-flash'
In /api/inventory/generate-order, surface upstream LLM errors to the client via an SSE 'error' event instead of silently returning an empty 200 stream so frontend can display a meaningful message

notes.auth_flow: Google OAuth interactive login not exercised (requires real Google account). Verified via manually seeded session_token per /app/auth_testing.md playbook. Owner endpoints (/api/owner/users) not exercised because no real owner session was created.
notes.manager_dashboard_ui: Not exercised via UI (requires real OAuth login). Backend endpoints backing it are all healthy.
notes.mocks_confirmed: WhatsApp confirmation is mocked: backend logger.info line executed on public appointment creation (server.py:608).
